subject.title: fix(gateway): avoid duplicate launchd restart bootstrap

question: Should OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_DOMAIN and OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_UID become supported macOS gateway restart controls, or should the PR rely only on automatic loaded-domain discovery?
rationale: The code can discover the loaded target with launchctl probing, while these two new environment inputs create a durable operator-facing compatibility contract that repository policy requires maintainers to choose deliberately.

options.title: Use automatic discovery only
options.body: Remove the new domain and UID overrides, preserve the loaded-domain probe, and avoid adding an undocumented environment-variable contract.

options.title: Adopt documented overrides
options.body: Keep the overrides only with explicit supported semantics, documentation, upgrade expectations, and focused compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Use automatic discovery only
recommendation.body: Remove the new domain and UID overrides, preserve the loaded-domain probe, and avoid adding an undocumented environment-variable contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature history shows the strongest sustained ownership signal across launchd lifecycle and gateway restart behavior.
